name: statement
description: One big statement on the chapter field: headline (≤ 6 words, *marker* words swipe yellow) and an optional body line. With paper:true the body is a hand-torn chit lying under the headline (definitions, fine print). Left-aligned on the shared edge. Optional: body may be an array of lines (or use \n) to break it on purpose; width (px, default 0 = full 860) narrows the chit/body so a mascot overlay can sit beside it without covering text. Optional: tilt (deg) fixes the chit's tilt instead of the seeded one; markerAt (s) is when the marker swipe starts (default 0.3). dy (px) nudges the whole composition down (+) or up (−) inside the content zone.

example.title: MDR kya hai?
example.body: Har payment pe dukaan wala bank ko jo *fee* deta hai. Card pe 0.90% tak.
